fragrances.name: Club de Nuit Milestone
fragrances.description: A salty sea-air scent with bergamot and a light red-fruit sweetness, drying down to violet, pale woods and ambroxan. It reads clean and breezy rather than sporty, and leans masculine despite being sold for everyone.
pros: Salty seaside freshness at a low price

fragrances.name: Khamrah Qahwa
fragrances.description: A spiced coffee gourmand: cinnamon, cardamom and ginger over praline and candied fruit, settling into coffee, vanilla, tonka and benzoin. It keeps the dessert-like warmth of Khamrah and adds a roasted coffee note to the base.
pros: Rich coffee-and-spice gourmand for little money

fragrances.name: Supremacy Not Only Intense
fragrances.description: Blackcurrant, apple and bergamot open onto a drier heart of lavender, patchouli and oakmoss over a musky ambergris base. It belongs to the fruity-mossy style made famous by Creed Aventus, with a denser, more ambery finish.
pros: Aventus-style fruit and moss for far less
cons: Opening can be sharp and loud
Easy to overspray in close quarters

fragrances.name: L'Aventure
fragrances.description: A sharp lemon-and-elemi opening over a light floral heart and a dry base of patchouli, amber and musk. Citrus-forward and woody, it is often suggested as a low-cost alternative in the Aventus style.

fragrances.name: Yara Moi
fragrances.description: Jasmine and soft peach open onto a caramel-and-amber heart, drying down to patchouli and sandalwood. Woodier and earthier than the original Yara, it pairs a sweet floral start with a darker base.
pros: Jasmine and caramel warmth at a low price
Less sugary than many sweet florals
cons: Patchouli base may feel dark to fans of the original Yara

fragrances.name: Club de Nuit Untold
fragrances.description: A saffron and jasmine opening over a glowing, slightly sugary amberwood and ambergris base with a resinous fir and cedar backbone. It is Armaf's widely cited take on Baccarat Rouge 540, airy but persistent.
pros: Close Baccarat Rouge 540 profile at a fraction of the price
cons: Amber can feel sharp or synthetic to some noses

fragrances.name: Baroque Rouge 540
fragrances.description: Saffron, pear and mandarin over a jasmine, ylang-ylang and lily heart, settling on amber, cashmere wood and musk. It is a widely cited low-cost alternative to Baccarat Rouge 540, following its airy saffron-and-amber outline with a more floral heart.
pros: Sweet, airy amber that suits any gender

fragrances.name: Bade'e Al Oud Honor & Glory
fragrances.description: Caramelised pineapple and crème brûlée open into a warm layer of cinnamon, turmeric and black pepper, then a creamy vanilla-sandalwood base. Despite the Bade'e Al Oud name it lists no oud and wears as a spiced fruity gourmand.
cons: Can feel heavy in high heat

fragrances.name: Ana Abiyedh Rouge
fragrances.description: Crisp pear and kumquat with bergamot sit over a caramel and geranium heart and a musky ambergris base touched with oakmoss. It wears as a citrusy amber with a light caramel sweetness and a clean musky finish.

fragrances.name: Sweet Like Candy
fragrances.description: Blackberry, pear and bergamot open onto a creamy heart of whipped cream, marshmallow and blackcurrant with jasmine and frangipani, drying down to vanilla and soft woods. It is openly sugary and playful, aimed at fans of sweet fruity scents.
pros: Fun sugary fruit and marshmallow profile

fragrances.name: Thank U, Next
fragrances.description: Pear and raspberry over a creamy coconut and rose heart, finishing on sugary macaron and musk. It reads as a light, sweet coconut-fruit scent suited to casual daytime wear.

fragrances.name: Bombshell Intense
fragrances.description: A darker, sweeter relative of Bombshell built on cherry, red peony and vanilla. It trades the original's bright, airy fruit-floral feel for a richer, more evening-leaning one.

fragrances.name: Cool Water Woman
fragrances.description: An aquatic floral that opens with melon, pineapple and quince, moves into a watery heart of lotus, water lily and lily-of-the-valley, and settles on musk, sandalwood and a little vanilla. It is the feminine counterpart to Cool Water and shares its clean, water-inspired style.

fragrances.name: Hawas Ice
fragrances.description: A cooler variation on Hawas for Him: crisp apple, lemon and bergamot with a hint of star anise over a plum, orange blossom and cardamom heart, settling on amber, driftwood and musk. It is fresh and sweet at once, built for warm-weather wear.
pros: Icy fruity freshness that stands out in heat
Strong performance for a fresh scent
cons: Close in style to many sweet-fresh scents

fragrances.name: Teriaq
fragrances.description: Caramel, bitter almond and apricot open onto honey, tart rhubarb and rose, then settle into a vanilla-leather base with labdanum and vetiver. The mix of burnt-sugar sweetness and a sharper leathery edge gives it more bite than a typical gourmand.
pros: Composed by Quentin Bisch at a budget price

fragrances.name: Asad Zanzibar
fragrances.description: Lavender and black pepper over a salty coconut-water and iris heart, drying to vanilla and a wisp of incense. A lighter, beachier flanker of Asad that keeps the peppery vanilla spine but adds a tropical, salty lift.
pros: Distinctive salty coconut and iris twist
cons: Divides opinion more than the original Asad
Powdery iris-vanilla drydown can feel soft

fragrances.name: Eclaire
fragrances.description: A dessert-style gourmand of caramel, milk and sugar with a touch of honey and white flowers over a vanilla, praline and musk base. Creamy and edible from start to finish, with very little freshness.
pros: Creamy caramel-milk gourmand at a low price

fragrances.name: Club de Nuit Iconic
fragrances.description: Grapefruit, lemon and mint with pink pepper open onto ginger and nutmeg, then settle into incense, cedar, sandalwood and amber. It follows the citrus-incense-woods structure of Bleu de Chanel and is widely treated as a budget alternative to it.
pros: Polished blue-style scent for little money
Works at the office and in the evening

reminds_of.name: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Parfum

fragrances.name: Club de Nuit Urban Man Elixir
fragrances.description: Bergamot and pink pepper over a lavender, geranium and elemi heart, with a dense ambroxan and amber base. A peppery, ambery fresh-spicy scent in the mainstream blue style, pitched louder than most.
cons: Smells similar to many designer blues

fragrances.name: Yara Tous
fragrances.description: Mango, passionfruit and coconut over jasmine, orange blossom and heliotrope, drying down to vanilla, musk and cashmeran. A tropical, summery flanker to Yara that keeps its soft, creamy base.
pros: Good value for a summer scent
cons: Can read like a body-care scent

fragrances.name: Hayaati
fragrances.description: An apple and bergamot opening warmed by cinnamon over a soft woody core, drying down to musk and vanilla. Simple and approachable, it sits between an easy daytime scent and a cosy evening one.
pros: Easy to wear for most ages

fragrances.name: Khamrah Dukhan
fragrances.description: Allspice, mixed spices and mandarin over incense and labdanum, settling into tobacco, praline, tonka and benzoin. A smoky, resinous take on the Khamrah line; Lattafa calls it unisex with a masculine lean.

fragrances.name: Teriaq Intense
fragrances.description: Boozy plum and cinnamon over a saffron-tinged bergamot opening, drying into a dense amber of tonka and benzoin. A dark, liqueur-like sweet amber suited to cold evenings.

fragrances.name: Supremacy Silver
fragrances.description: Apple, pineapple and bergamot over a light patchouli-jasmine heart, with oakmoss and a faint birch smokiness giving a dry woody edge before musk and ambergris take over. A low-cost take on the fruity-smoky style associated with Creed Aventus.
pros: Fruity-smoky profile at a low price

fragrances.name: Supremacy Collector's Edition
fragrances.description: Pineapple, apple and bergamot lead into orange blossom and a touch of birch, then settle into ambergris, musk and oakmoss. A sweet fruity-chypre scent with a white-floral heart and a warm ambery base, in the Supremacy line's pineapple style.
cons: Close to many fruity pineapple releases
Sweetness may be too much for some

fragrances.name: 9am Dive
fragrances.description: Sharp lemon, mint and pink pepper with a tart blackcurrant edge, moving through apple, cedar and a light incense before a sandalwood, patchouli and ginger base. Bright and cool, it suits hot days and casual wear.

fragrances.name: Supremacy In Heaven
fragrances.description: Bergamot and mandarin over a green-tea and blackcurrant heart, resting on soft musk, sandalwood and woods. Crisp and clean, with the same note outline as Creed Silver Mountain Water.

fragrances.name: L'Aventure Intense
fragrances.description: Resinous elemi and lemon open onto a light jasmine and lily-of-the-valley heart, then settle into patchouli, amber and musk. It lists the same notes as the original L'Aventure, as a citrus-woody scent for day or evening.
pros: Bright citrus with a woody backbone
cons: Can feel generic among citrus-woody scents
Floral heart is easy to miss

fragrances.name: L'Aventure Femme
fragrances.description: Pineapple, blackcurrant and berries over bergamot, opening onto a rose and freesia heart with a cedar edge, then drying down to sandalwood, patchouli, musk and amber. A fruity floral with a noticeably woody base.
pros: Woody base keeps it from feeling sugary
Low price for an eau de parfum
cons: Soft projection after a few hours

fragrances.name: Amber Oud Ruby Edition
fragrances.description: Saffron and bitter almond over jasmine and cedar, drying into a glowing ambergris, woods and musk base. Airy, sweet and faintly metallic; its note list mirrors that of Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait.
pros: Far cheaper than the scent it follows

fragrances.name: Amber Oud Aqua Dubai
fragrances.description: Bergamot, mandarin and green notes over a melon, pineapple and blackcurrant heart, with galbanum and petitgrain keeping it green above a soft musk-vanilla base. A bright citrus-green scent in extrait strength.
cons: Fruit accord may read synthetic to some

fragrances.name: Amber Oud Tobacco Edition
fragrances.description: Spiced tobacco leaf with ginger, cinnamon and clove over a sweet core of tonka, vanilla and cocoa, finishing on dried fruit and woods. A dense, cosy spiced-tobacco scent in the vein of Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille.
pros: Much cheaper than luxury tobacco scents

fragrances.name: Amber Oud Carbon Edition
fragrances.description: Bergamot, lavender and rosemary over a sage and geranium heart with a marine note, settling into moss, cedar and vetiver. A fougère-style aromatic freshness with a cool, slightly salty edge.
cons: Traditional profile may feel dated to some

fragrances.name: Vulcan Feu
fragrances.description: Ripe mango and ginger with a tart rhubarb-lemon edge, softened by a praline, jasmine and violet heart and grounded in cedar, ambergris, tonka and moss. Fruity, spicy and sweet at once; sold as an extrait de parfum.
cons: Fruity sweetness can be too much for some

fragrances.name: Club de Nuit Intense Man Limited Edition Parfum
fragrances.description: Lemon, lime, pineapple and bergamot with black and pink pepper, over a soft floral heart of jasmine, rose and freesia, drying down to white musk, ambroxan, ambergris and cedar. A 2021 limited Parfum in the Club de Nuit Intense Man line whose listed notes lean citrus and musk rather than the birch smoke of the original.
cons: Easy to confuse with other Club de Nuit Intense Man versions

fragrances.name: Club de Nuit Urban Man
fragrances.description: Grapefruit, mint and cardamom open into lavender, ginger and nutmeg over a dry base of vetiver, cedar and patchouli. A fresh, spicy-aromatic everyday scent with a clean, slightly bitter woody finish.
pros: Fresh spicy profile suited to office wear
cons: Settles close to the skin fairly quickly

fragrances.name: Shaghaf Oud Aswad
fragrances.description: Saffron, thyme and rose lead into a spiced heart of cumin and coriander around oud, then settle into leather, sandalwood, amber and a soft vanilla-musk. A dark, rosy oud with an animalic, spicy edge.
pros: Dark rose-oud character at a low price
cons: Cumin gives a sweaty edge some dislike
Too dense for office or heat

fragrances.name: R.E.M.
fragrances.description: Fig and quince sit over salted caramel and marshmallow, with a lavender thread that keeps the sweetness from turning purely sugary. It settles into creamy tonka, sandalwood and musk, soft and a little dreamy.

fragrances.name: God Is a Woman
fragrances.description: Juicy pear and musky ambrette lead into a powdery orris-and-rose heart, then a vanilla and soft cedar base. It wears as a clean, easygoing fruity floral rather than anything bold.
pros: Brand states a mostly naturally derived formula

fragrances.name: Mod Vanilla
fragrances.description: A creamy vanilla musk built around white praline and cocoa butter, with plum up top and a powdery orris-jasmine touch in the heart. It stays close and comforting, closer to warm skin than to dessert.

fragrances.name: Cloud Pink
fragrances.description: A tropical spin on the Cloud line: pineapple, dragon fruit and berries up top, coconut water and orchid in the middle, then a musky praline and amberwood base. Juicy and playful, it suits warm days.

fragrances.name: Moonlight
fragrances.description: Black currant and plum meet fluffy marshmallow and peony, finishing in creamy sandalwood, amber and vanilla. A darker, fruitier sweet scent that feels most at home in the evening and in cooler months.

fragrances.name: Mod Blush
fragrances.description: Passion fruit and raspberry with a pinch of pink pepper open onto magnolia, rose and pear, before a clean ambroxan and woods base takes over. Brighter and fresher than Mod Vanilla, with a modern musky finish.

fragrances.name: Cloud 2.0 Intense
fragrances.description: A denser take on Cloud that pairs lavender, pear and bergamot with a heavier dose of coconut cream and praline over musky blond woods. Same fluffy character as the original, with more body on skin.

fragrances.name: Curious
fragrances.description: A creamy white floral of tuberose and jasmine lifted by pear and magnolia, resting on vanilla musk and pale woods. Sweet and soft, in the classic celebrity-fragrance mould.

fragrances.name: Midnight Fantasy
fragrances.description: Dark cherry, plum and raspberry over a powdery orchid and iris heart, finishing in soft vanilla, amber and musk. Sweet and fruity like the original Fantasy, but darker and more suited to nights out.

fragrances.name: Circus Fantasy
fragrances.description: Raspberry and sugared apricot open onto orchid, peony and water lily, settling into vanilla and musk with a soft violet and woody finish. Lighter and more playful than Fantasy, it fits daytime and warm weather.

fragrances.name: Believe
fragrances.description: Guava and tangerine over linden blossom and honeysuckle, with a patchouli, amber and praline base that gives it an earthier edge than a straight fruity floral. A fruity amber that wears easily.
pros: Patchouli keeps the sweetness in check

fragrances.name: Hidden Fantasy
fragrances.description: Opens with bright orange, tangerine and grapefruit, then warms as clove and lily arrive over a creamy amber, vanilla and sandalwood base. It moves from citrus to cosy, one of the warmer, spicier Fantasy flankers.

fragrances.name: Radiance
fragrances.description: A musky white floral of tuberose, jasmine and orange blossom with a berry opening and a soft iris note, drying down to cashmere wood, amber and musk. More floral and grown-up than the Fantasy line.

fragrances.name: Private Show
fragrances.description: A gourmand of creamy coffee and dulce de leche brightened by clementine and nectarine, with jasmine and orange blossom softening the sweetness over amber and musk. Dessert-like and playful.
pros: Cheap for an eau de parfum
cons: Dries down to a simple musk

fragrances.name: Reb'l Fleur
fragrances.description: Plum, red berries and peach lead into a tropical floral heart of tuberose, violet, hibiscus and coconut water, grounded by vanilla, patchouli and amber. Sweet, bold and a little sultry.

fragrances.name: Nude
fragrances.description: Guava, mandarin and pear over gardenia, jasmine sambac and orange blossom, drying down to a soft musk and sandalwood skin scent with a touch of vanilla. Lighter and cleaner than Reb'l Fleur.

fragrances.name: Rogue
fragrances.description: A dense amber floral: pink pepper and lemon blossom give way to rose, jasmine and plum with a soft suede edge, settling into vanilla, patchouli and amber. Warm and rich, best in cooler weather.

fragrances.name: Rogue Man
fragrances.description: Bergamot, clementine and black pepper open onto cedar and labdanum, finishing in a warm amber and tonka base with patchouli and sandalwood. A smooth, slightly sweet woody amber for evenings.

fragrances.name: RiRi
fragrances.description: Mandarin, cassis and passion fruit with a splash of rum open a fruity floral that moves through freesia, jasmine and honeysuckle to a smooth vanilla, benzoin and sandalwood base. Bright and sweet without much weight.

fragrances.name: Hot Water
fragrances.description: Bitter wormwood and green basil open onto a hot red-pepper and patchouli core, drying down to resinous benzoin and styrax. Spicy and herbal, it sits well apart from Davidoff's fresh aquatics.

fragrances.name: Champion
fragrances.description: Lemon and bergamot over a green galbanum and clary sage heart, finishing on dry cedar with a light touch of oakmoss. A crisp, uncomplicated sporty freshie.
pros: Very cheap for the bottle size

fragrances.name: The Game
fragrances.description: A dry woody aromatic that opens with a gin-like juniper brightness, then settles onto soft iris and dark woods. Fairly linear and low-key, it works as an everyday scent rather than a statement.
cons: Projection drops after the first hour

fragrances.name: Adventure
fragrances.description: Citrus, pepper and a green, tea-like mate note open onto a toasted sesame and pimento heart, then a smooth base of cedar, vetiver and white musk. Mild and well mannered, it is far tamer than its rugged name suggests.

fragrances.name: Silver Shadow
fragrances.description: A woody oriental that opens on bitter orange, coriander and cedar, warms through saffron, clove and patchouli, and settles on benzoin, amber and cinnamon. Quiet and grown-up in tone.

fragrances.name: Run Wild for Him
fragrances.description: Ginger and cinnamon open onto an aromatic lavender heart, resting on resinous fir and sweet tonka bean that add a faint forest edge. It sits between a fresh lavender fougère and a cosy spiced scent.
pros: Lavender with a warm spiced twist
Fir resin adds an outdoorsy note

fragrances.name: The Secret
fragrances.description: A cool mint and grapefruit opening turns into a spiced apple heart with cinnamon and pepper, drying to tonka, soft leather and musky woods. Sweet-spicy, approachable and sold at a low price.

fragrances.name: Blue Seduction for Men
fragrances.description: A cool aquatic with melon, mint and bergamot up front, a lightly spiced marine heart with green apple and a faint coffee note, and a soft woody-amber finish. Crisp and sweet-fresh in the classic blue-freshie style.

fragrances.name: The Golden Secret
fragrances.description: A sweet apple opening with mint and green notes leads into a warm heart of cumin, nutmeg and pepper, finishing on cedar, leather and musk. Warmer and spicier than The Secret, and better suited to cool evenings.

fragrances.name: King of Seduction
fragrances.description: Grapefruit, pineapple, melon and apple open onto a marine heart touched with neroli and cardamom, drying to cedar, vetiver and soft suede and musk. A clean, sweet-fresh everyday scent.
pros: Fine for office and casual wear

fragrances.name: Tease
fragrances.description: Juicy pear with lychee, apple and mandarin over gardenia and soft white flowers, settling into a dark, sugary vanilla with hints of chocolate, amber and musk. Soft and cosy with a flirtatious edge, it sits in the youthful sweet-vanilla lane.

fragrances.name: Eilish
fragrances.description: Mandarin, red berries and sugared petals open onto a vanilla heart laced with cocoa, gentle spice and a touch of rose, over warm amber, musk, tonka and woods. Cosy, sweet and fairly close to the skin.

fragrances.name: Eilish No. 2
fragrances.description: Bergamot and apple blossom meet incense and black pepper, then papyrus and poppy lead into palo santo, dark ebony wood, a little vanilla and skin musk. Cooler, darker and more gender-neutral than the first Eilish.
cons: Peppery incense opening can feel sharp

fragrances.name: Heat
fragrances.description: Candied peach and magnolia sit over an almond and honeysuckle heart, settling into sweet amber, tonka and musk. Sugary and warm, it projects strongly at first and then softens.

fragrances.name: Pulse
fragrances.description: Pear blossom and a splash of orange liqueur lead into a light orchid, peony and jasmine bouquet over a vanilla and musk base. Sweet, soft and easygoing.
cons: Pear dominates for a long time

fragrances.name: Paris Hilton
fragrances.description: Watery melon, crisp apple and peach lead into a bouquet of freesia, mimosa, jasmine, lily and a touch of tuberose, over soft sandalwood, oakmoss and musk. Bright and clean with a distinctly 2000s feel.
cons: Watery melon opening can feel sharp

fragrances.name: Heiress
fragrances.description: A bubbly fruity floral: passion fruit, orange and peach with a champagne-like fizz, softening into tiare, jasmine and honeysuckle over tonka, violet leaf and pale woods. Sweet, tropical and upbeat.

fragrances.name: Glow by JLo
fragrances.description: Grapefruit, neroli and orange blossom lead into a soft rose, jasmine and tuberose heart, with a strong, lightly sweet musk underneath touched by orris, sandalwood and amber. The overall effect is of fresh-from-the-shower skin.
cons: Can smell like soap to some
